description: List and inspect project or group labels. Actions: list (all labels with search filtering), get (single label by ID or name). Related: manage_label to create/update/delete.

include_ancestor_groups.description: Include ancestor groups when listing or getting labels

label_id.description: The ID or title of the label Required for 'get' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

search.description: Keyword to filter labels by Required for 'list' action(s).

with_counts.description: Include issue and merge request counts Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_labels
